Class KfePaymentRequestService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentrequest.adapters.in.KfePaymentRequestService
@Service public class KfePaymentRequestService extends Object
Creates, expires, hides, cancels, and projects participant/public payment requests across supported rails.
